images.caption: Figure 4:PACT-Check results for PLatour and PLatour-SFT. Panels (a)–(c) show Qwen3 results, and panel (d) shows Qwen3.5 domain averages. Each benchmark is normalized independently, with Receiver Alone at 0% and the evaluated PACT system at 100%. Bars show the fraction of the system’s gain reproduced by each control (DT, IT, SC, and TR); darker bars mark the strongest control. Gain and PACT-Score report absolute accuracy differences in percentage points: Gain compares the system with Receiver Alone, while PACT-Score compares it with the strongest control. A positive PACT-Score indicates performance beyond all tested controls, providing evidence for a benefit from sender information. In panel (b), TR uses the better of full-parameter SFT and LoRA-SFT for each benchmark to provide an SFT-matched comparison. MATH500 is marked “no-gain” because PLatour-SFT underperforms Receiver Alone. Per-benchmark accuracies are reported in TablesA20andA21.
